run_test_server: run the polymetis test server entry point using hydra config to instantiate and run a robot client
run_robot_client: run a robot client by instantiating it from hydra config and calling its run method
instantiate_robot_client: instantiate a robot client object from the hydra test_server config using hydra.utils.instantiate
add_build_dir_to_path: add the polymetis build directory to the system PATH environment variable for test execution
review_main_entry: review the polymetis test server main entry point that sets up PATH and runs a configured robot client
